value.name: Asha enters sewing room
value.description: Asha steps into the tidy sewing room and stops to take in the space.

value.name: Rosa identifies Lucia's work area
value.description: Rosa explains that this room was where Lucia handled her bills and kept important papers.
evidence: "This is where she did her bills," Rosa said.
"And the folder you mentioned. The bottom drawer."

value.name: Asha inspects desk without opening it
value.description: Asha studies the roll-top desk carefully but refuses to open it, keeping her hands behind her back.
evidence: Asha did not open the desk.
She put her hands behind her back, the way she had been taught in evidence class a lifetime ago, and looked at it.

value.name: Asha asks about room access after death
value.description: Asha asks whether anyone has entered the room since Lucia died, probing for possible tampering.
evidence: "Has anyone been in this room since she died?"

value.name: Rosa admits room was accessed
value.description: Rosa says she has dusted the room and that Miss Lucia sometimes sits there, indicating others have been inside.
evidence: "I have. To dust. Miss Lucia has. She sits in here sometimes."

value.name: Asha asks about Daniel's access
value.description: Asha specifically asks whether Daniel has been in the room, suggesting suspicion about his involvement.

value.name: Rosa reports uncertain room access
value.description: Rosa cannot say for certain whether Daniel entered, but recalls the room door being closed on Saturday and open earlier in the week.
evidence: "I do not know for certain. I came on Saturday to bring food and the door to this room was closed, and earlier in the week it had been open. That is the only thing I noticed."

value.name: Rosa confirms key always stayed in lock
value.description: Rosa says the desk key was always left in the lock because Lucia was not afraid of her children reading her papers.
evidence: "The key was always in the lock. The señora was not afraid of her children reading her papers."

value.name: Asha closes sewing room and postpones opening desk
value.description: Asha leaves the room, closes the door, and insists on returning with everyone present before the desk is opened.
evidence: Asha looked at the desk a moment longer. Then she stepped back into the hallway and pulled the sewing room door gently closed behind her.
"I'd like to come back tomorrow with everyone present before this is opened."
